newsitem.title: UK: Conrad in deal for Sheffield United.
newsitem.headline: Conrad in deal for Sheffield United.

text.p: Sheffield United football club will announce plans next week to float on the London stock market through a 10 million stg reverse takeover with leisure group Conrad, the Daily Telegraph said on Saturday.

"It is thought that the company, which earlier this year lost out in the battle for Leeds United, was looking for a big city club with a loyal following which did not over-value itself," the newspaper said.

Conrad, which owns Bobby Charlton sports business and sportswear brand Le Coq Sportif, was also said to be interested in Alan Pascoe's Sponsorship Group, but the newspaper said the Sheffield deal would not any link with Pascoe unlikely.
